text: Rust's borrow checker prevents data races at compile time, so a program can share memory between threads without a garbage collector.
gloss: Rust's borrow checker prevents data races at compile time, so a program can share memory between threads without a garbage collector.

text: Der Borrow-Checker von Rust verhindert Data Races schon beim Kompilieren, sodass ein Programm Speicher zwischen Threads ohne Garbage Collector teilen kann.
gloss: Rust's borrow checker prevents data races at compile time, so a program can share memory between threads without a garbage collector.

text: Le vérificateur d'emprunts de Rust empêche les accès concurrents aux données dès la compilation, si bien qu'un programme peut partager la mémoire entre threads sans ramasse-miettes.
gloss: Rust's borrow checker prevents data races at compile time, so a program can share memory between threads without a garbage collector.

text: El verificador de préstamos de Rust evita las condiciones de carrera en tiempo de compilación, de modo que un programa puede compartir memoria entre hilos sin recolector de basura.

text: Проверка заимствований в Rust предотвращает гонки данных на этапе компиляции, поэтому программа может разделять память между потоками без сборщика мусора.
gloss: Rust's borrow checking prevents data races at compile time, so a program can share memory between threads without a garbage collector.

text: Rustの借用チェッカーはコンパイル時にデータ競合を防ぐため、ガベージコレクタなしでスレッド間でメモリを共有できる。

text: Rust 的借用检查器在编译期就能防止数据竞争，因此程序可以在没有垃圾回收器的情况下在线程之间共享内存。
gloss: Rust's borrow checker prevents data races at compile time, so a program can share memory between threads without a garbage collector.

text: Rust의 빌림 검사기는 컴파일 시점에 데이터 경쟁을 막아 주므로, 프로그램은 가비지 컬렉터 없이 스레드 간에 메모리를 공유할 수 있습니다.
gloss: Rust's borrow checker prevents data races at compile time, so a program can share memory between threads without a garbage collector.
